name: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes vs TheraNest
title: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes vs TheraNest: Mental Health EHR Comparison (2026)
description: Compare SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, and TheraNest for therapists. See differences in pricing, features, telehealth, billing, documentation, and which EHR is best for your practice.

summary.bottom_line: SimplePractice offers the most polished all-in-one experience with built-in e-prescribing and the widest feature set. TherapyNotes is purpose-built for behavioral health with clinical templates designed by clinicians and includes 24/7 support. TheraNest provides the most budget-friendly entry point at $29/month with flexible per-therapist pricing.

key_differences.e_prescribing: SimplePractice (yes, add-on) vs TherapyNotes (no) vs TheraNest (no)
key_differences.customer_support: TherapyNotes (24/7) vs SimplePractice (limited) vs TheraNest (business hours)
key_differences.insurance_claims: TherapyNotes ($0.14/claim) vs SimplePractice ($0.25/claim) vs TheraNest (30 free, then varies)

sections.heading: SimplePractice vs TherapyNotes vs TheraNest: Overview
sections.content: SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, and TheraNest are the three most popular practice management and EHR platforms for mental health clinicians. All three offer scheduling, clinical documentation, billing, telehealth, and client portals. SimplePractice serves the broadest audience including wellness professionals beyond mental health. TherapyNotes was built specifically for behavioral health by a clinical psychologist and web developer duo. TheraNest (now part of Ensora Health) targets therapists seeking affordable, scalable pricing. Your choice depends on whether you prioritize features, mental health specialization, or budget.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: TheraNest offers the lowest entry point at $29/therapist/month (Essentials), making it attractive for budget-conscious solo practitioners. SimplePractice starts at $49/month for Starter (limited features) with the full-featured Plus plan at $99/month. TherapyNotes charges $69/month for solo practitioners or $79/month for the first clinician in group practices plus $50/month for each additional clinician. For a solo therapist wanting comprehensive features, annual costs are roughly: TheraNest Premier at $1,068/year, SimplePractice Plus at $1,188/year, and TherapyNotes Solo at $828/year. TherapyNotes also offers the cheapest claims at $0.14 each versus SimplePractice's $0.25.

sections.heading: Feature Comparison
sections.content: SimplePractice is the only platform offering e-prescribing (via DrFirst, $49/month add-on), making it essential for prescribers. All three platforms now offer AI-powered documentation assistants at similar price points ($35-40/month). TherapyNotes differentiates with clinical note templates designed by actual clinicians and the only 24/7 phone support in this comparison. TheraNest integrates with Wiley Treatment Planner for evidence-based treatment planning. SimplePractice offers the most extensive calendar integrations including Google, Apple, and Outlook.

sections.heading: Telehealth Capabilities
sections.content: All three platforms include HIPAA-compliant telehealth, but availability varies by plan. SimplePractice includes telehealth on Essential ($79) and Plus ($99) plans with HD video and screen sharing. TherapyNotes includes basic telehealth on all plans for free, with Premium Telehealth ($15/month) adding HD video, screen sharing, and closed captions. TheraNest restricts integrated telehealth to the Premier plan ($89/month); lower tiers require a separate telehealth solution. If telehealth is central to your practice, factor this into your total cost calculation.

sections.heading: Customer Support
sections.content: TherapyNotes stands out with 24/7 phone and email support on all plans, free data import assistance, and unlimited training resources. SimplePractice support is more limited, primarily email-based with restricted phone hours. TheraNest offers business-hours support. If responsive customer service matters to you, especially during off-hours or weekends when you're catching up on admin work, TherapyNotes has a clear advantage.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Match the platform to your practice needs:

recommendations.when: You need e-prescribing capabilities, you want the most polished all-in-one experience, you serve clients beyond mental health (wellness, nutrition), you prioritize extensive integrations and calendar sync, or you want a platform backed by significant funding (Vista Equity Partners)

You want a platform built specifically for behavioral health, you value 24/7 customer support, you need the cheapest per-claim insurance billing ($0.14), you appreciate clinical templates designed by clinicians, or you want a bootstrapped company focused solely on mental health

Budget is your primary concern ($29/month starting price), you're a solo therapist building a practice, you want per-therapist pricing flexibility, you need Wiley Treatment Planner integration, or you prefer shorter commitment with a 21-day trial

faqs.q: Which is cheaper: SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, or TheraNest?
faqs.a: TheraNest is cheapest at $29/therapist/month for the Essentials plan. TherapyNotes Solo is $69/month. SimplePractice Starter is $49/month but has limited features. For full-featured plans: TheraNest Premier ($89/mo), SimplePractice Plus ($99/mo), TherapyNotes Group ($79 + $50/additional clinician).

faqs.q: Which EHR has the best telehealth for therapists?
faqs.a: All three offer HIPAA-compliant telehealth. TherapyNotes includes basic telehealth free on all plans. SimplePractice includes telehealth on Essential and Plus plans. TheraNest requires the Premier plan ($89/mo) for integrated telehealth. For premium telehealth features like HD video and screen sharing, TherapyNotes charges $15/month extra.

faqs.q: Does SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, or TheraNest support e-prescribing?
faqs.a: Only SimplePractice offers e-prescribing through DrFirst integration at $49/month plus $89 setup fee. Neither TherapyNotes nor TheraNest currently offer e-prescribing. If you're a prescriber, this may make SimplePractice your only option among these three.

faqs.q: Which platform has the best customer support?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes offers 24/7 phone and email support on all plans, making it the clear leader for customer service. SimplePractice has more limited support hours. TheraNest provides business-hours support. TherapyNotes also offers free data import assistance.

faqs.q: Are SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, and TheraNest HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, all three platforms are fully HIPAA compliant and provide Business Associate Agreements (BAAs). They all offer encrypted data storage, secure messaging, and HIPAA-compliant telehealth options.

faqs.q: Which EHR is best for group practices?
faqs.a: For group practices, TherapyNotes offers unlimited free administrative staff on all plans. SimplePractice charges $74/month per additional provider on the Plus plan. TheraNest's per-therapist pricing scales predictably. TherapyNotes' group pricing ($79 + $50/additional) becomes more economical at larger sizes.
